messages:
deploy-bot: Starting gradual rollout: model=rwd-xl-v3, weightset=w-2026-03-11-1, canary=10 hosts, start=1778901234
incbot: ALERT: canary error rate spike detected — 5xx and tokenizer errors. paging oncall. summary: ~8% failing, latency up on canary.
oncall-sre: Oncall here, looking. which artifact was promoted?
emily: It's the new bundle from the release pipeline: bundle id bndl-03-11-1. Logs show `tokenize()` raising ValueError: unknown token id.
raj: Also seeing generation truncation and odd control chars in outputs on canary. Samples attached in thread.
marta: Quick check: weightset label is `w-2026-03-11-1` but deploy manifest referenced tokenizer `token-v2.0`. Canaries report `token-v2.1` loaded.
carla: Confirmed: orchestrator applied new tokenizer package by mistake; the bundle dependency matrix has mixed tokenizer version.
oncall-sre: Customer impact?
frontline-support: Impacting a small fraction but visible: 12 customers reported malformed responses in last 10m, 3 active support tickets, several failing synthetic checks. No major revenue customers yet but escalating.
oncall-sre: Action plan: 1) STOP rollout (feature flag flip), 2) rollback canary hosts to previous stable weightset, 3) kill-switch if rollback fails. Agree?
emily: I can flip the rollout flag now (`feature.model_rollout`). flipping.
deploy-bot: Feature flag `feature.model_rollout` -> OFF (emily) at 1778901260
oncall-sre: Good. Initiating rollback to `w-2026-02-28-stable` on all canary nodes.
raj: Rolling back via `orchctl promote --target weight=w-2026-02-28-stable --scope canary` — kicked at 1778901272.
incbot: Rollback started. Notifying oncall rotation and paging channel.
carla: While rolling back, we're freezing artifact promotions until root cause triage completes.
se-team: We'll audit the bundle dependency graph and cross-check release manifest for tokenizer pins. ETA 30m.
frontline-support: Notified affected customers with temporary mitigation steps; flagging any follow-ups to support queue.
oncall-sre: Monitor canary metrics. If errors persist after rollback, execute kill-switch to route traffic off canaries.
emily: Rollback in progress. saw orchestration success on 6/10 nodes so far.
raj: 10/10 nodes now rolled back and healthy at 1778901320. error rate back to baseline.
incbot: Canary error rate resolved to normal band. updating incident status.
oncall-sre: Marking incident mitigated. Next: RCA and postmortem. Immediate findings: release pipeline allowed tokenizer mismatch due to missing explicit pin for token package in bundle manifest.
marta: Proposed short-term fix: block pipeline promotion if tokenizer != pinned version in manifest.
carla: Also adding an integration test that loads tokenizer and runs small tokenization smoke test as part of canary prechecks.
se-team: We'll regenerate corrected bundle with consistent tokenizer and weights, test locally, and schedule a re-rollout after sign-off.
frontline-support: Customer impact summary will be prepared for 1778901600 update. No further customer escalations reported.
oncall-sre: Handoff note: oncall shift at 1778901420 — handoff to next oncall with incident context and follow-ups list.
incbot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: eng-ml (marta, carla). Postmortem requested.
emily: Leaving notes in the deploy run and tagging PRs: #fix/tokenizer-pin and #test/tokenizer-smoke.
oncall-sre: Thanks everyone. Will close after postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
